questions.question:
Which two numbers need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a399f4825f5d1ff1409bebd037b4dd13ae9ad85d3b4070467d6a96849724e24.png] 

Option 1) : 7 and 2

Given equation : 7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 2 + 56 ÷ 8 × 7 - 13 = 11

⇒ 2 + __**56 ÷ 8**__ × 7 - 13 = 11

⇒ 2 + __**7 × 7**__ - 13 = 11

⇒ __**2 + 49**__ - 13 = 11

⇒ __**51 - 13**__ = 11

⇒ 38 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 8 and 2

Given equation : 7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 7 + 56 ÷ 2 × 8 - 13 = 11

⇒ 7 + __**56 ÷ 2**__ × 8 - 13 = 11

⇒ 7 + __**28 × 8**__ - 13 = 11

⇒ __**7 + 224**__ - 13 = 11

⇒ __**231 - 13**__ = 11

⇒ 218 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 7 and 13

Given equation : 7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 13 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 - 7 = 11

⇒ 13 + __**56 ÷ 8**__ × 2 - 7 = 11

⇒ 13 + __**7 × 2**__ - 7 = 11

⇒ __**13 + 14**__ - 7 = 11

⇒ __**27 - 7**__ = 11

⇒ 20 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 7 and 8

Given equation : 7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 8 + 56 ÷ 7 × 2 - 13 = 11

⇒ 8 + __**56 ÷ 7**__ × 2 - 13 = 11

⇒ 8 + __**8 × 2**__ - 13 = 11

⇒ __**8 + 16**__ - 13 = 11

⇒ __**24 - 13**__ = 11

⇒ **11 = 11**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"7 and 8".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

r _ k n _c _ _ h _ _ b c b t _ k _ b c b

options.text: h b c q k n h n
h b b s k n h c
h c b s k n b n
h b b s k n h n

questions.solution:
Given :- r _ k n _c _ _ h _ _ b c b t _ k _ b c b

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) h b c q k n h n → r **h** k n **b** c **c - q** h **k n **b c b - t **h** k **n** b c b

2) h b b s k n h c → r **h** k n **b** c **b - s** h **k n** b c b - t **h** k **c** b c b

3) h c b s k n b n → r **h** k n **c** c **b - s** h** k n** b c b - t **b** k **n** b c b

4) h b b s k n h n → r **h** k n **b** c **b**** - s** h **k n** b c b - t **h** k **n** b c b

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42d20ff5cd54c42e0c3e21f37ea6b88384a22ed03421ea8b2a7fe5ae1249fae7.png] 
 
• Option (4) give the pattern of :- r h k n b c b - s h k n b c b - t h k n b c b

Hence, the correct answer is **"h b b s k n h n".**

questions.question: Five years ago, the ratio of the ages of Tarun and Saurabh was 4 ∶ 1. After five years, the ratio of their ages will be 2 ∶ 1. What is the present age (in years) of Saurabh?
questions.solution:
Given, 

Five years ago, the ratio of the ages of Tarun and Saurabh was 4 ∶ 1.

⇒ (Tarun - 5)/(Saurabh - 5) = 4/1

⇒ Tarun - 5 = 4(Saurabh - 5)

⇒ Tarun - 5 = 4Saurabh - 20

⇒ 4Saurabh - Tarun = 15 ............. (i)

After five years, the ratio of their ages will be 2 ∶ 1.

⇒ (Tarun + 5)/(Saurabh + 5) = 2/1

⇒ Tarun + 5 = 2(Saurabh + 5)

⇒ Tarun + 5 = 2Saurabh + 10

⇒ 2Saurabh - Tarun = - 5 .............. (ii)

By solving equation (i) and (ii) we get,

4Saurabh - Tarun = 15

2Saurabh - Tarun = - 5

⇒ 2Saurabh = 20

⇒ Saurabh = 10 years

∴ Here, the present age of Saurabh is 10 years.

Hence, the correct answer is **"10".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** According to the question

we have multiplied by 1 and 3 to make the age difference equal.

since there is a difference of 10 years in the past and future age

2→ 10, 1→ 5

so Saurabh 5 years later age = 5 × 3 = 15 years

so present age of Saurabh age is = 15 - 5 = 10 year

questions.question: A cube of side 49 cm is painted purple on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 7 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes having only one face printed.
questions.solution:
Here cube of n × n formulae is:

 
• Cube of no side painted = (n - 2)³
 
• Cube of one side painted = 6 × (n - 2)²
 
• Cube of two side painted = 12 × (n - 2)
 
• Cube of three sides painted = Always 8 

A cube of side 49 cm is painted purple on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides of 7 cm each.

⇒ n = 7

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'ONION' is coded as 201 and 'POTATO' is coded as 261. How will 'MANGO' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52189335c86db068f6e331c0e8f7daa6a1257af029eec7648e3047c46ae48a3b.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of alphabet positional value × 3**

'ONION' is coded as 201.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfc96b39ca6da5152b37a2746a7f4a53cbd95f730f8032b571fa8a118b579be8.png] 

= (15 + 14 + 9 + 15 + 14) × 3

= 67 × 3

= 201

and

'POTATO' is coded as 261.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e721b27b55c2a7c0b9730141f6adda5d43b925bca92ed26cbe75e7f328f90b1.png] 

= (16 + 15 + 20 + 1 + 20 + 15) × 3

= 87 × 3

= 261

Similarly,

'MANGO' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44d61b9d3073fbef1286040b4764fc5c708369393481b2384f8a7948592a631d.png] 

**= (13 + 1 + 14 + 7 + 15) × 3**

**= 50 × 3**

**= 150**

Hence, the correct answer is **"150".**
